description: Founder of a fitness app. English.

memories.label: project_pulse
memories.title: Pulse fitness app
memories.content: The user is building Pulse, a habit-based fitness app for busy parents with 10-minute workouts.

memories.label: idea_streaks
memories.title: Family streaks
memories.content: Gamification idea for Pulse: shared family streaks where kids can 'high-five' a parent's finished workout.

memories.label: pref_design
memories.title: Minimal UI, big buttons
memories.content: The user wants Pulse's UI minimal with large tap targets, one primary action per screen and a lime accent colour.

memories.label: decision_pricing
memories.title: Freemium, €4.99/month
memories.content: The user decided Pulse will be freemium with a €4.99 monthly premium tier.

memories.label: special_knee
memories.title: Knee injury
memories.content: The user had ACL surgery last year and avoids jumping exercises.

memories.label: task_testflight
memories.title: TestFlight build
memories.content: The user needs to ship a TestFlight build of Pulse to 20 beta families.
